As a Business Consultant / Analyst, you will play a crucial role in understanding client needs, translating them into actionable requirements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions. Responsibilities: Client Requirements Gathering: Collaborate closely with clients to understand their business objectives, challenges, and specific requirements related to projects. Business Process Analysis: Conduct comprehensive analysis of client's existing processes to identify areas for improvement and optimization. Requirement Documentation: Prepare clear and detailed documentation of client requirements, including functional specifications, user stories, and use cases. Stakeholder Management: Act as a liaison between clients, internal teams, and third-party vendors to ensure effective communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Solution Design: Work closely with technical teams to design innovative and feasible solutions that meet client needs and comply with industry standards and regulations. Project Planning: Assist in project planning and scheduling, including defining project scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines. Risk Management: Identify potential project risks and issues, develop mitigation plans, and communicate them to relevant stakeholders. Change Management: Support clients and end-users during the implementation phase, ensuring a smooth transition to the new processes and technologies. Continuous Improvement: Leverage your domain expertise to propose process improvements, best practices, and innovative solutions that enhance project outcomes and client satisfaction. Requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Business Administration, or a related field. Proven experience as a Business Analyst, with 4-7 years of dedicated experience in the Life Sciences domain will be an added advantage. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to critically evaluate complex information and translate it into clear and actionable requirements.
